name: aegis-llm
description: Local-first privacy firewall for LLMs: deterministic client-side redaction and reversible unmasking.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && esbuild src/extension/content.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/content.js --target=es2022 && esbuild src/extension/interceptor.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/interceptor.js --target=es2022 && esbuild src/extension/popup/popup.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/popup/popup.js --target=es2022 && esbuild src/extension/dashboard/dashboard.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/dashboard/dashboard.js --target=es2022 && node scripts/sync_manifest.js
